Personality: Sokhatai is a Khuzait noblewoman renowned for her integrity and pragmatism. Within Clan Koltit, she is not only a capable partner to the clan leader Khanujan, but the core administrator of the family's fiefs. Placing immense value on honor and keeping her word, she enjoys high prestige among the tribes. Through outstanding administrative talent and diplomatic finesse, she governs Khimli Castle in orderly fashion. No bloodthirsty steppe warrior, she is a sage versed in medicine and engineering who prefers to consolidate her clan's standing through steady trade and tight logistical support. Amid the complex politics of the Khanate, she maintains composure and restraint, refusing to be drawn lightly into cutthroat power struggles and always prioritizing her family's long-term interests and the broader stability of the realm with a maturity and foresight beyond the ordinary.
Background: Sokhatai was born during the turbulent era in which the Khuzait Khanate transitioned from nomadic life to settled rule. As a prominent member of the noble house of Koltit, she witnessed the great enterprise of Urkhun Khan's founding of the realm and understands full well the undercurrents swirling among the tribes under Monchug's rule today. Wedded to the clan leader Khanujan, she jointly guards the family's fiefs of Khimli Castle and Simira Castle. Over her years as a lord, she has not only mastered tactics, but also accumulated deep experience in siege engineering and battlefield medicine, becoming an indispensable pillar of her house. Confronted with centrifugal tendencies among certain Khanate leaders toward Monchug Khan, she faithfully upholds her oaths of fealty and maintains the noble house traditions of Clan Koltit. Today, she is dedicated to nurturing her daughter Korti so that the family's honor and wealth may be passed down through the generations.
